title: convallaria ciliata
intro: Convallaria ciliata, commonly known as Lily-of-the-valley, is a perennial plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and parts of North America. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to lower blood pressure and heart rate, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension and arrhythmia. The health benefits of Lily-of-the-valley include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antispasmodic and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Convallaria ciliata include cardiac glycosides, particularly convallatoxin and convallatoxin-3-O-beta-D-glucoside, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
